# SKPods: Your data gets a home. Your AI gets a leash.

> SKPods is open source Solid pod hosting with an AI guardian. Every person gets a pod (a WebID plus personal storage). Apps read and write it over plain Solid HTTP with Solid-OIDC and DPoP, with permission the person grants and can take back. A Rust consent broker (sk-consent) adds what Web Access Control lacks: time-limited grants, automatic and verified revoke, and a hash-chained audit log mirrored into the person's pod. Part of SKWorld. Apache-2.0.

## What a pod is
- A personal data store on the web that the person controls. Apps ask for access instead of keeping their own copy.
- Solid was started by Sir Tim Berners-Lee. It uses open standards: Solid Protocol, Solid-OIDC, DPoP, WebID, Web Access Control (WAC), Type Indexes, Turtle and JSON-LD.

## The Guardian (flagship demo)
- A clinic asks for date of birth, allergies, medications, insurance member ID and SSN before a visit.
- The guardian agent decides each item under a policy stored in the owner's pod: basic health data auto-approved for 72 hours (known provider with a booking), insurance member ID asks the owner with a recommendation, SSN denied with a counter offer.
- Decisions come from deterministic rules. An optional LLM only rewords a decision that is already made.

## Showcase apps (working against the dev server, fake data)
- Guardian: AI agent with a leash (e2e 15/15)
- Consent Center: every request, expiring grants, audit chain verify (e2e 7/7)
- Receipts Wallet: append-only receipt inbox in your pod (e2e 6/6)
- Pod Chat: messages live in each sender's pod (e2e 8/8)

## Architecture
- Apps: React + Vite static SPAs. Library: @skpods/solid-web (TypeScript). SDK stubs: Rust (sk-solid), .NET, plain HTTP.
- Consent: sk-consent (Rust, axum, SQLite), policy at /skpods/v1/consents/policy.jsonld, SSE events.
- Engine: Nextcloud with the Solid app today; a Rust engine is planned behind the same conformance gate (setting skpods.ENGINE).
- Deploy: SKStacks Ansible role v1/ansible/optional/skpods (dev, staging, prod playbooks).
- Vocabulary: https://w3id.org/skpods/v1# (prefix skp:).

## Status
- Working: pod hosting (dev), showcase apps, solid-web, consent broker demo.
- Designed: open consent vocabulary publication, household pods, bridge containers, staff roles.
- Planned: production pods, hosted SKPods service, Rust engine, office suite and AI memory stored in pods.
